question: How can archaeologists tell which way carts moved through the streets of Pompeii?
answer: From scrapes on the kerbstones. A cart turning a corner grinds its wheel against the kerb on one side, so the wear shows which way it turned. Mapping such marks and the ruts in stepping stones, Eric Poehler reconstructed a system in which many streets were one-way. The pavement kept the traffic log.
move: Wear marks record what nobody thought worth writing down.
source: Poehler, The Traffic Systems of Pompeii, 2017
reference: Poehler, The Traffic Systems of Pompeii, Oxford University Press, 2017
